name: Titanium.Media.AudioRecorder
summary: An audio recorder object used for recording audio from the device microphone.
description:
Use the [Titanium.Media.createAudioRecorder](api:Titanium.Media#createAudioRecorder) method to create an audio recorder.

Ensure to request the permissions for audio-recording before starting a new record-session.
This can be done by using [Titanium.Media.hasAudioRecorderPermissions](api:Titanium.Media#hasAudioRecorderPermissions) to check whether
audio-permissions are granted and [Titanium.Media.requestAudioRecorderPermissions](api:Titanium.Media#requestAudioRecorderPermissions) to
request audio-permissions.

**Android Platform Note**: On Android, you also need to include the following permission
into the `<android>` section of the tiapp.xml:

``` xml
<android xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android">
    <manifest>
        <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.RECORD_AUDIO" />
    </manifest>
</android>
```

All Android devices support the default recording, which uses the format
[Titanium.Media.AUDIO_FILEFORMAT_WAVE](api:Titanium.Media#AUDIO_FILEFORMAT_WAVE) and the compression [Titanium.Media.AUDIO_FORMAT_LINEAR_PCM](api:Titanium.Media#AUDIO_FORMAT_LINEAR_PCM).
Some Android devices do not support all other values of the `format` and `compression` properties.
If the device does not support the values that you set, the `start` method writes an error to
the log and the `recording` property stays `false`. Read the `recording` property after you call
the `start` method. If it is `false`, use the default values.

properties.name: compression
properties.summary: Audio compression to be used for the recording.
properties.description:
On Android, set this property before you call the `start` method.
Android supports these values:

* [Titanium.Media.AUDIO_FORMAT_LINEAR_PCM](api:Titanium.Media#AUDIO_FORMAT_LINEAR_PCM)
* [Titanium.Media.AUDIO_FORMAT_AAC](api:Titanium.Media#AUDIO_FORMAT_AAC)
* [Titanium.Media.AUDIO_FORMAT_HE_AAC](api:Titanium.Media#AUDIO_FORMAT_HE_AAC)
* [Titanium.Media.AUDIO_FORMAT_AAC_ELD](api:Titanium.Media#AUDIO_FORMAT_AAC_ELD)
* [Titanium.Media.AUDIO_FORMAT_AMR_NB](api:Titanium.Media#AUDIO_FORMAT_AMR_NB)
* [Titanium.Media.AUDIO_FORMAT_AMR_WB](api:Titanium.Media#AUDIO_FORMAT_AMR_WB)

On Android, the [Titanium.Media.AUDIO_FILEFORMAT_WAVE](api:Titanium.Media#AUDIO_FILEFORMAT_WAVE) format always records linear PCM
and ignores this property. All other formats cannot record linear PCM. If you use
[Titanium.Media.AUDIO_FORMAT_LINEAR_PCM](api:Titanium.Media#AUDIO_FORMAT_LINEAR_PCM) with one of these formats, the recorder uses AAC.
The [Titanium.Media.AUDIO_FILEFORMAT_AAC](api:Titanium.Media#AUDIO_FILEFORMAT_AAC) format does not support the two AMR compressions.

properties.name: format
properties.summary: Audio format to be used for the recording.
properties.description:
On Android, set this property before you call the `start` method.
Android supports these values:

* [Titanium.Media.AUDIO_FILEFORMAT_WAVE](api:Titanium.Media#AUDIO_FILEFORMAT_WAVE)
* [Titanium.Media.AUDIO_FILEFORMAT_MP4](api:Titanium.Media#AUDIO_FILEFORMAT_MP4)
* [Titanium.Media.AUDIO_FILEFORMAT_AAC](api:Titanium.Media#AUDIO_FILEFORMAT_AAC)
* [Titanium.Media.AUDIO_FILEFORMAT_3GPP](api:Titanium.Media#AUDIO_FILEFORMAT_3GPP)

The default value on Android is [Titanium.Media.AUDIO_FILEFORMAT_WAVE](api:Titanium.Media#AUDIO_FILEFORMAT_WAVE).

properties.name: paused
properties.summary: Indicates if the audio recorder is paused.

properties.name: recording
properties.summary: Indicates if the audio recorder is recording.

properties.name: stopped
properties.summary: Indicates if the audio recorder is stopped.

methods.name: stop
methods.summary: Stops the current audio recording and returns the recorded audio file.
